```python
import random

# Function to generate a palindrome
def generate_palindrome(sentence):

# List of common English sentences
sentences = [
    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.",
    "A man, a plan, a canal, Panama.",
    "Was it a car or a cat I saw?",
    "Do geese see God?",
    # Add more sentences if needed
]

# Select a random sentence from the list
sentence = random.choice(sentences)

# Generate and print the palindrome
palindrome = generate_palindrome(sentence)
print(palindrome)
```
